exact_q04e_arabic_span.text: السابع : هو كثرة الأصحاب والأمة والأشياع ; قاله أبو بكر بن عياش ويمان بن رئاب .

arabic.text: والكوثر : العدد الكثير من الأصحاب والأشياع .

english.text: Al-Kawthar means the great number of companions and supporters.

why_not_q04e: Both spans occur in the first lexical issue before the second issue's sixteen numbered interpretations.
The lexical Arabic and English omit الأمة, which appears in Q04E.
The lexical spans omit both Abu Bakr ibn Ayyash and Yaman ibn Ri'ab.
The English contains no seventh-interpretation marker.

translation_coverage.repair_scope: Additive checkpoint only; earlier staging is not silently rewritten.

voice_and_claim_boundary.safe_statement_en: Al-Qurtubi's seventh interpretation identifies al-Kawthar as abundance of companions, the community, and followers and attributes the shared view to Abu Bakr ibn Ayyash and Yaman ibn Ri'ab.
voice_and_claim_boundary.shared_interpretation: abundance of companions, the community, and followers
voice_and_claim_boundary.context_note: Qurtubi prefers the first and second interpretations because they have prophetic textual support; this seventh view remains separately reported.
